返回小日账

邮件记账隐私说明

  • 绑定 Gmail 是可选功能。Google 的 Gmail 只读授权允许应用读取邮箱。小日账按你在应用内添加的发件地址和检查时间范围查询消息，使用收件时间、主题、发件地址和正文识别扣款。
  • 浏览器与 Gmail API 直接通信，并在本机识别邮件正文。小日账不会把原始邮件、附件或 Gmail 授权令牌发送给项目维护者。待确认草稿、发件地址和检查进度保存在当前设备，短期令牌保存在浏览器会话中。
  • 只有确认的扣款才会生成流水。流水包含你确认的记账字段和用于去重的来源标识。若启用 Google Drive 同步，流水会写入你自己的 Drive 应用专用空间。若导出账本，流水也会包含在相应文件里。
  • 可以在「设置 → 邮件记账」解除绑定，清除本机的邮件配置、草稿和检查进度。已入账的流水可在账本中删除。也可以在 Google 账号的第三方连接中撤销访问权限。

Gmail privacy notice

Gmail linking is optional and requests read-only access. The app queries dates and sender addresses you configure and uses message headers and body text to identify charges in your browser. Mail is never changed. Drafts, sender preferences, and scan progress stay on this device. The browser session holds the short-lived access token. The app does not send raw mail or Gmail tokens to the project maintainer.

After you confirm a charge, the ledger stores its approved fields and a deduplication identifier. The ledger can be exported and, if you enable Drive sync, saved in your own Drive app data. Disconnect Gmail in the app to remove its local settings and drafts. Remove posted entries from the ledger or revoke access through Google Account connections.

The app's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adhere to the Google Workspace API User Data and Developer Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
